cognates.3: Numeric literal; identical in every locale.
cognates.30: Numeric literal; identical in every locale.
cognates.Deck: Nextcloud app name; kept untranslated in all 18 finished locales.
cognates.DSAR: Acronym (data subject access request); kept untranslated in all 18 finished locales, so following that.
cognates.Id: Kept as 'Id' in all 18 finished locales; following that rather than diverging on casing alone.
cognates.ID:: Identifier acronym plus a colon. Estonian, unlike French, puts no space before a colon.
cognates.ID: {id}: Identifier acronym, colon and a placeholder — nothing translatable remains.
cognates.Min ms: 'Min' abbreviates 'miinimum' in Estonian exactly as it abbreviates 'minimum' in English, and 'ms' is the SI symbol; both are invariant.
cognates.Host *: 'Host' is the established Estonian loanword for a network host; Nextcloud core et_EE renders 'Host' too.
cognates.Ollama URL: Product name plus an invariant acronym; Estonian would add no article or genitive here, so the label is unchanged.
cognates.Port: 'Port' is the established Estonian loanword for a network port; Nextcloud core et_EE renders 'Port' too.
cognates.RBAC: Access-control acronym, used untranslated in Estonian technical writing.
cognates.Register: 'Register' is the Estonian noun, spelled identically; the app's existing et glossary already uses it (plural 'Registrid').
cognates.Register:: The Estonian noun 'Register' plus a colon; Estonian, unlike French, puts no space before a colon.
cognates.URL: Invariant in Estonian; 'URL' is the standard form.
cognates.UUID:: Identifier acronym plus a colon. Estonian puts no space before a colon, unlike fr which carries 'UUID :'.
cognates.{property} - {other}: Two placeholders and an ASCII hyphen, which Estonian keeps. Stays wrapped in the source because ru localises the hyphen to an em dash.
cognates.N/A: Abbreviation shown as-is; not translated in this UI.
cognates.ConfigSet: Apache SOLR product term; SOLR does not localise it and the admin UI names the same object.
cognates.ConfigSet:: Apache SOLR product term with its label colon; see ConfigSet.
cognates.HNSW index: Algorithm name (hierarchical navigable small world); an invariant technical term.
cognates.OpenCorporates: Proper noun — a third-party service name.
cognates.OpenRegister: Proper noun — this application's own name.
cognates.http://localhost:11434: A literal example URL shown verbatim; not prose.
cognates.https://api.fireworks.ai/inference/v1: A literal example URL shown verbatim; not prose.
cognates.https://api.your-dolphin-instance.com: A literal example URL shown verbatim; not prose.
cognates.https://example.com/webhook: A literal example URL shown verbatim; not prose.
A literal API-key prefix example shown verbatim; not prose.
A literal API-key prefix example shown verbatim; not prose.
A literal organisation-id prefix example shown verbatim; not prose.
cognates.X-Custom-Header: value\nAuthorization: B: Literal HTTP header example; header names are protocol tokens and are never translated.
cognates.X-Custom-Header: value\\nAuthorization:: Literal HTTP header example with an escaped newline; header names are protocol tokens.
cognates.objectType: object\\naction: created: Literal CloudEvents payload example; the field names are protocol tokens.
cognates.objectType: object\naction: created: Literal CloudEvents payload example; the field names are protocol tokens and are never translated.
cognates.Browser Web Push (VAPID): Browser and Web Push are the protocol's own names and VAPID is its acronym; the protocol name is not translated.
cognates.Bucket: Object-storage term, used unchanged in this locale's technical language.
cognates.Driver: Database-driver term, used unchanged in this locale's technical language.
cognates.Host: Networking term, used unchanged in this locale.
cognates.myapp: A literal example application id shown verbatim; not prose.
cognates.Survivor: Master-data-management term for the record that survives a merge; used unchanged in data-governance language.
cognates.Avatar: International term, unchanged in Estonian; Nextcloud core et renders it identically.
cognates.Link: Same spelling and meaning in Estonian.
cognates.Register #{id}: 'Register' is identical in Estonian and the rest is a number sign and a placeholder.
